name: Ben-Hajil
title: Envoy of the King of Judah for Teaching the Law
summary: Ben-Hajil was one of the princes whom King Jehoshaphat of Judah sent out to teach the people the law of the Lord. He was part of a group of leaders who traveled through the cities of Judah together with Levites and priests to teach the people God's word. His service was an important part of Jehoshaphat's religious reform program.

keyEvents.title: Sent out by King Jehoshaphat
keyEvents.description: Ben-Hail was appointed as one of the princes that King Jehoshaphat sent out in his third year to teach the people in the cities of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Teaching in the Law of the Lord
keyEvents.description: Together with other princes, Levites and priests, Ben-Hail traveled throughout all the cities of Judah and taught the people from the Book of the Law of the Lord.

keyEvents.title: Part of Jehoshaphat's religious reform
keyEvents.description: Ben-Hail's service was part of King Jehoshaphat's broader reform work that led to the fear of the Lord falling upon the kingdoms around Judah, so that they did not wage war against them.

keyEvents.title: Jehoshaphat strengthening Judah
keyEvents.description: The teaching mission in which Ben-Hail participated was connected to Jehoshaphat's efforts to strengthen Judah spiritually and militarily, as the king walked in the ways of the Lord.
